description: Convert a location between coordinate formats in one call: decimal degrees, DMS, degrees-decimal-minutes, UTM (Krüger series, WGS-84, Norway / Svalbard zones), MGRS military grid, geohash (with cell size), Maidenhead ham-radio locator and Open Location Code (plus code). Auto-detects the input format, including free-form DMS like 40°26'46"N 79°58'56"W. Offline, deterministic. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/coord-convert

mgrsDigits.description: MGRS precision digits per axis (5 = 1 m)
